items.html: And let us now explain the existence of this drop. It is known that all the drops are the phase of the shape of a small Yod, as mentioned in Tikkun 2, page 46. And it has three tips, which are the secret of the three letters YAHU, which are the secret of Hochma, Bina, and Daat, for from there too this drop was extended, as is known. And behold, since this drop went out only from three names, AB, MA, BON alone, for the name SAG did not help it except to pass through in general, therefore this drop must have the entirety of the three YAHU: one from AB, one from MA, and one from BON.
